argumentation_roles.lesson: Use topology/mechanism diagrams only where they define variables or interaction structure.
Avoid dozens of repetitive RSSI plots; consolidate into aligned small multiples and distinguish log-domain statistics from power aggregation.
Use shared axes and common metrics across models; captions must name the actual target (throughput vs PHY Rate).
Formula-based prediction should be plotted as an explicit baseline next to ML residual/direct predictions and error quantiles.
